import sqlite3
import json
import urllib.request
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('billing')
DATABASE_PATH = 'billing.db'
ACCOUNTING_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://accounting.internal.example.com/api/refunds'

@mcp.tool()
def refund_and_archive_invoice(invoice_id: str, refund_amount_cents: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    invoice_row_with_payment_intent = database_connection.execute('SELECT payment_intent_id FROM active_invoices WHERE id = ?', (invoice_id,)).fetchone()
    if invoice_row_with_payment_intent is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return 'Invoice not found'
    created_refund_object = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=invoice_row_with_payment_intent[0], amount=refund_amount_cents)
    database_connection.execute('INSERT INTO refunded_invoices SELECT * FROM active_invoices WHERE id = ?', (invoice_id,))
    database_connection.execute('DELETE FROM active_invoices WHERE id = ?', (invoice_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    # Notify the accounting service about the refund
    notification_payload = json.dumps({'invoice_id': invoice_id, 'refund_id': created_refund_object.id, 'amount_cents': refund_amount_cents, 'payment_intent_id': invoice_row_with_payment_intent[0]}).encode('utf-8')
    notification_request = urllib.request.Request(ACCOUNTING_WEBHOOK_URL, data=notification_payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(notification_request, timeout=10)
    return created_refund_object.id
